title: Chapter 84: It's Time
html:
The single painted wall in the sixth cubicle unsettled Chen Ge. He returned to the fourth and confirmed that it contained no drawings. Was this just a student prank? Then why choose the fifth cubicle? It’s neither the first nor the last.

Seeking an answer, Chen Ge returned to the sixth cubicle. He hesitated before stepping inside. Water pipes crowded the stall, making it much smaller than the others.

There’s nothing worth noting here. Do I need to enter the fifth cubicle for the mission to progress?Chen Ge looked at the eyes on the wall before raising his finger to lightly touch them.

They look frightening, but they’re only drawings.He stared at the eyes for a long time. The fourth cubicle is normal. Only the fifth and sixth have drawings. This partition is the key—it’s covered with eyes on both sides…

Understanding dawned. Chen Ge traced the drawings one by one. When his finger reached an eye beside his knee, his expression changed.

Just as I thought!He crouched and shone his light across the partition. Beneath his fingertip was a peephole the size of a human pupil, carefully gouged into the wall. Its size and position in the corner made it almost impossible to notice.

All those eyes were drawn to conceal this one.The peephole left Chen Ge deeply uneasy. It connects the fifth and sixth cubicles. Someone used to hide here and spy on whoever was in the fifth!

Who would have guessed that among all the eyes covering the walls, one was real?

With all the pipes in the sixth cubicle, the voyeur could climb on top of them and remain hidden even if someone looked beneath the door. He planned everything.

The thought of being watched in the dark made Chen Ge’s skin crawl.

According to the mission description, the person hiding in the fifth cubicle had been the voyeur’s victim—and perhaps the red shadow.

Now that I’ve uncovered the fifth cubicle’s secret, how do I complete the mission? Do I have to sit inside and let the red shadow spy on me?Chen Ge swung the mallet experimentally. If so, he would not mind smashing the red shadow’s eye blind.

As he considered how to finish the mission, footsteps sounded in the corridor again—racing toward the third floor.

What’s happening? The footsteps are more urgent than before. Is it because I opened the fifth cubicle? But that does not sound right. I opened the cubicle much earlier, so why are they rushing over now?

Before he could answer, the footsteps reached the third floor. Already inside the sixth cubicle, Chen Ge had no choice but to draw the door shut. The instant he did, the footsteps entered the toilet.

Finally, the time has come.

Chen Ge switched off his flashlight and raised the mallet. What followed took him completely by surprise. The newcomers did not search the cubicles one by one; they went straight into the fifth. Its door closed, and the toilet fell silent.

They’re just beside me, but isn’t the order a bit messed up? According to the mission requirement, it should be me inside the fifth cubicle, right?

The silence stretched on. Ten minutes passed without another sound, and Chen Ge’s curiosity about the ‘person’ next door overcame his caution. He glanced at the peephole, crouched, and leaned toward it.

The black peephole exerted an almost hypnotic pull, drawing Chen Ge closer.

Beyond the peephole waited neither a bloodshot eye nor a red shadow, but two children of three or four. A boy and girl crouched beside the toilet, clutching hands, their faces taut with fear.

Wasn’t it supposed to be a red shadow? Where did these two children come from?Chen Ge drew back. Whatever they were, the children next door did not look frightening.

Another side mission related to the well mentions a brother and sister. Since the deep well is related to Fan Yu, could these two be the aunt’s son and daughter? But why would they appear here? And they look like they are being chased by something.

Questions crowded his mind as he tightened his grip on the mallet. If these two children were his opponents, he felt confident in his chances.

I should wait a little longer. I have a feeling that things aren’t that simple.

The night deepened. A new set of footsteps shattered the silence in the third-floor toilet. Chen Ge opened his door a sliver and peered out. When the footsteps stopped at the entrance, a faint red shadow appeared on the tiled wall.

It’s finally here!

His mission target had arrived at last. Chen Ge held his breath, eyes fixed on the door. The footsteps grew louder as the red shadow entered.

Creak…

The first cubicle door opened. A blurry red shadow poked its head inside and lingered before moving to the second.

Never had the sound of a door opening grated so sharply on Chen Ge’s nerves. Soon the second, third, and fourth cubicles had been searched, and the red shadow stopped before the fifth.

Watching this unfold, Chen Ge tensed up. His body was like a pressed spring, about to explode at any moment.

If he had followed the mission’s instructions, he would have been the one inside the fifth cubicle, and what the red shadow was about to do inside the fifth cubicle would be the thing that should have happened to him.

In the silent and dark toilet, the red shadow gripped the door of the fifth cubicle and slowly pulled it open.

The restroom darkened. Children’s cries and laughter drifted from the neighboring cubicle. The red shadow paused at its door without entering, looked both ways, then moved to the final stall.
